stories.title: Un detalle que conmueve; Pac recibió una camiseta de Liga MX antes de morir

en.title: A touching detail; Pac received a Liga MX jersey before dying
en.summary: Pac received a Liga MX jersey shortly before his death, according to reports.

stories.title: AMLO reaparece para presentar su nuevo libro; reitera su retiro de la política

en.title: AMLO reappears to present his new book; reiterates his retirement from politics
en.summary: Former Mexican President AMLO released a video discussing his new book titled "Pueblo", which he describes as complementing his ideological framework of Mexican humanism previously outlined in his 2025 book "Grandeza".

stories.title: Huracán Rachel se mantiene en categoría 1; prevén lluvias intensas para Jalisco, Colima y Michoacán

en.title: Hurricane Rachel maintains category 1 status; intense rainfall expected for Jalisco, Colima and Michoacán
en.summary: Hurricane Rachel is forecast to intensify to category 2 in the early hours of October 1, with heavy rain expected across several Mexican states.

stories.title: Nacional Monte de Piedad pone fin a huelga tras casi un año de conflicto; STPS anuncia acuerdo con sindicato

en.title: Nacional Monte de Piedad ends strike after nearly a year of conflict; STPS announces agreement with union
en.summary: An agreement was reached to end a prolonged strike at Nacional Monte de Piedad following over 70 negotiation meetings between the labor ministry and the union.

stories.title: Inician construcción y rehabilitación de centro para menores en Isla Mujeres, Quintana Roo; obra costará casi 6 mdp

en.title: Construction and rehabilitation of youth center begins in Isla Mujeres, Quintana Roo; project costs nearly 6 million pesos
en.summary: Municipal authorities have initiated construction and renovation of a facility for minors in Isla Mujeres. The municipal government will provide equipment including beds, stoves, refrigerators, air conditioning units, furniture, and computers.

stories.title: AMLO reaparece con nuevo libro y se lo dedica a Sheinbaum; "la mejor Presidenta del mundo", dice

en.title: AMLO reappears with new book and dedicates it to Sheinbaum; calls her "the best President in the world"
en.summary: Former president AMLO has released a new book dedicated to current President Sheinbaum, offering praise for her leadership.

stories.title: Nacional Monte de Piedad y sindicato ponen fin a conflicto laboral tras casi un año de huelga

en.title: Nacional Monte de Piedad and union end labor conflict after nearly one year of strike
en.summary: Nacional Monte de Piedad and its union have resolved a prolonged labor dispute. Both parties signed a final agreement at the Labor Ministry offices on September 30, 2026.

stories.title: Por primera vez Isla Mujeres tendrá un Centro de Asistencia Social; Mara y Verónica Lezama arrancan su construcción y rehabilitación

en.title: Isla Mujeres will have a Social Assistance Center for the first time; Mara and Verónica Lezama begin its construction and rehabilitation
en.summary: Isla Mujeres is establishing its first Social Assistance Center to provide round-the-clock specialized care for children and adolescents. The facility will operate seven days a week in the continental zone of Isla Mujeres.

stories.title: Acuerdan, tras un año, levantar huelga en Monte de Piedad

en.title: After one year, strike at Monte de Piedad is lifted
en.summary: Mexico's Labor Department announced the end of a strike by workers at Nacional Monte de Piedad that lasted nearly one year.

stories.title: Estados aprueban reforma sobre nacionalidad única; aplicará a partir de las elecciones de 2028

en.title: States approve reform on single nationality; will apply starting from 2028 elections
en.summary: Mexican states approved a constitutional reform regarding single nationality that will take effect during the 2028 electoral process.

stories.title: Avala el Senado la reforma sobre doble nacionalidad de candidatos

en.title: Senate approves reform on dual nationality of candidates
en.summary: The Senate approved a constitutional reform requiring presidential, gubernatorial, and capital city government candidates to hold exclusively Mexican nationality.

stories.title: Ante cercanía de Rachel como huracán categoría 1, cierran puerto de Manzanillo

en.title: With Hurricane Rachel approaching as Category 1, Manzanillo port closes
en.summary: The port of Manzanillo was closed as tropical storm Rachel approached, with Colima state authorities preparing for the storm's impact.

stories.title: DeepSeek y Huawei unen fuerzas para reducir la dependencia de Nvidia en chips de IA

en.title: DeepSeek and Huawei join forces to reduce Nvidia chip dependency in AI
en.summary: DeepSeek released open-source tools designed for Huawei's Ascend chips to promote artificial intelligence development on Chinese hardware.

stories.title: Cancelación de vuelos de Aeroméxico y Volaris al Aeropuerto de Tulum recrudece crisis turística en el destino

en.title: Cancellation of Aeroméxico and Volaris flights at Tulum Airport worsens tourism crisis in destination
en.summary: Flight suspensions by Aeroméxico and Volaris intensify challenges for Tulum, a destination struggling with occupancy rates amid pricing concerns and increased international competition.

stories.title: Murió su hermano y Alberto Baillères cambió sus planes: terminó repartiendo cerveza en un camión

en.title: His brother died and Alberto Baillères changed his plans: he ended up distributing beer in a truck
en.summary: Alberto Baillères' father established a rule requiring him to learn any business from the ground level before leading it, a principle that shaped his career trajectory.

stories.title: El Valor de Educar: de programa de becas a trampolín profesional para 8,500 jóvenes mexicanos

en.title: The Value of Education: from scholarship program to professional springboard for 8,500 young Mexicans
en.summary: Constellation Brands transformed its scholarship initiative into a comprehensive support program that has benefited 8,500 Mexican youth in their professional development.

stories.title: El Valor de Educar: Constellation Brands hace entrega de 1,500 becas en Sonora, Coahuila y Veracruz

en.title: The Value of Education: Constellation Brands awards 1,500 scholarships in Sonora, Coahuila and Veracruz
en.summary: Constellation Brands distributed 1,500 scholarships across three Mexican states as part of its Excellence program, bringing total beneficiaries to 8,500 students nationwide.
